panels.description: overall request rate per minute over last 3 minutes
panels.title: Overall Request Rate

panels.description: percentage of HTTP status 5xx/4xx in all requests

targets.expr: sum(duration_milliseconds_count{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", service_name="$app", http_status_code=~"(5.*|4.*)", http_route!~"^/health$", http_route=~"$route"})/sum(duration_milliseconds_count{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", service_name="$app", http_route=~"$route", http_route!~"^/health$"})

panels.title: Overall Error Rate

panels.description: request rate per minute over last 2 minutes
panels.title: Request Rate

panels.description: by route and http status code

targets.expr: sort_desc(duration_milliseconds_sum{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", service_name="$app", http_status_code!="", http_route!~"^/health$", http_route=~"$route"} / duration_milliseconds_count{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", service_name="$app", http_status_code!="", http_route!~"^/health$", http_route=~"$route"})

panels.title: Average Latency

targets.expr: sum(rate(duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="$app", http_route!~"^/health$", http_route=~"$route", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"}[2m])*60) by(service_name, http_method, http_route)
sum(rate(duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="$app", http_route!~"^/health$", http_route=~"$route", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"}[2m])*60) by(service_name, http_method, http_route)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name="$app", http_route=~"$route", http_route!~"^/health$", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"}[2m])) by (le, service_name, http_method, http_route))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name="$app", http_route=~"$route", http_route!~"^/health$", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"}[2m])) by (le, service_name, http_method, http_route))

sum(duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="$app", http_route!~"^/health$", http_route=~"$route", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", http_status_code!~"2.*|3.*"}) by(service_name, http_method, http_route) / sum(duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="$app", http_route!~"^/health$", http_route=~"$route", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"}) by(service_name, http_method, http_route)

sum(duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="$app", http_route!~"^/health$", http_route=~"$route", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", http_status_code!~"2.*|3.*"}) by(service_name, http_method, http_route) / sum(duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="$app", http_route=~"$route", http_route!~"^/health$", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"}) by(service_name, http_method, http_route)
